test_quantile_basic: test DataFrame.quantile to compute the median quantile across all numeric columns
test_quantile_axis: test DataFrame.quantile with axis=1 to compute quantiles across columns per row
test_quantile_multi: test DataFrame.quantile with a list of quantiles to return multiple percentile values
test_quantile_interpolation: test DataFrame.quantile with different interpolation methods like nearest or linear
test_quantile_numeric_only: test DataFrame.quantile with numeric_only=True to exclude non-numeric columns
